answer: Cross-epoch footprint continuity freezes any sable-tagged identity whose transaction graph, latency profile, and signing cadence diverge from its prior epoch beyond a set threshold. Jade epoch hashes of counterparties and timing are compared with that footprint to flag cloned histories. An attacker must build and maintain a separate consistent history per identity; any shale-level mismatch voids deposit and fees, adding repeated setup and operation cost per sybil.
